title: Sony unveils luxury Walkman MP3 players starting at $1,899
excerpt: Sony announces three new high-end Walkman portable media players, with prices ranging from $1,899.99 up to a gold-plated $5,899 model.
body_html:
Sony has revealed a new lineup of three portable media players under the Walkman brand, targeting high-end audio consumers with exceptionally high price tags.

The entry-level model in the new trio is the NW-ZX900, which begins at $1,899.99. Moving up the range, the NW-WM1AM3 is priced at $2,999.99. At the top of the lineup is the gold-plated NW-WM1ZM3, which reaches $5,899.

According to the details, the $2,999.99 WM1AM3 model is nearly identical in specification to the more expensive gold-plated version, omitting only the decorative gold shell.
